referrals_in.option: resolution_logic rule: positive "melanocytic markers (HMB-45 / Melan-A / SOX10)"
referrals_in.reason: Melanocytic markers are positive. Melanoma is the mimic Goyal and Tembhare both name for interdigitating dendritic cell sarcoma ... This is a melanoma, not a dendritic cell neoplasm; it belongs in ICCC-3 Group XI ... no Group II code is emitted.
referrals_in.topography_on_hop: The Stage 1 site, kept (any site; Group II has no tree_routing and is occurs_at_any_site, router 354-425). Absent when an express-lane case took "The file does not state the site"; then canHop() is false (app.js:2315-2321) and the referral screen shows no hop button.
referrals_in.lands_tree: The tree Group XI routes the kept site to: g11_melanoma at C40-C42, C47, C49, C77 and the other R8 sites; at a carcinoma site (C44 skin, C11, C69 ...) that site's tree, which must jump to the melanoma histology node by cross-tree next_node.
referrals_in.needs: Every Group XI tree offers melanoma at its first histology question and jumps to a melanoma node that is not the melanoma tree's document_inventory.

referrals_in.option: label: "Melanin-pigmented or melanocytic proliferation; HMB-45, Melan-A or SOX10 positive"
referrals_in.reason: Melanocytic tumour of the meninges - meningeal melanocytoma, meningeal melanomatosis or meningeal melanoma ... ICCC-3 files the melanoma morphologies 8720 and 8728 in XId, malignant melanomas, across all topographies. Code this case from the Group XI tree.

The referral reason calls melanocytoma a Group XI case; ICCC gives 8728/1 no group (registrar question).

dual_group_rules.effect: resolveGroup() (app.js:290) feeds only the "Group routing" note on the output (app.js:2285, 2639); no rule decides which group a case enters.

group_10_rules.what_they_do: Topography picks the tree with no question (app.js afterGroup 3376, routedTree 3362); every lookup code that lists 10 is named by a rule; the default is required by app.js and is the extragonadal tree; occurs_at_routed_sites lets the typed lane enter Group X at a routed site whose candidate_groups omit 10 when the term's entries list the site in primary_sites (app.js:3284-3299).

required_groups_11.occurs_at_any_site: absent (it would let every Group XI-only term survive at every site; occurs_at_routed_sites reads the entries' primary_sites instead)

rules.label: Sites with no Group XI carcinoma subgroup (melanoma, and the any-site XIa and XIb codes, only)

default.reason: Every lookup code is named by a rule; app.js routedTree() requires a default (app.js:3362-3374).

handoff.note: Validated by check_presentation_router(); app.js does not read it.

constraints: Each rule entry_node is a document_inventory (or a lab_results node whose next_node is one) in group_11_dt.json, and its tree_id is declared there (build_database.py check_presentation_router, ~12150-12205).
One rule per tree is the contract's convention (section 0.4); no build check enforces it and app.js routedTree() accepts it either way.

The melanoma tree is entered at its document_inventory only from the R8 sites; every other tree reaches melanoma by a cross-tree next_node to a melanoma histology node, because app.js replaces captured evidence_tests at each document_inventory.
A Group 10 RULE 4 analogue (build_database.py:10625) recomputes the rules from ICCC-2017 ranges 118-136 against the lookup on every build, so a lookup code added later without a rule fails by name.

route_by_morphology.note: candidate_groups is the string "route_by_morphology"; narrowBySite() leaves the candidates unfiltered (app.js:3208) and afterSearchSite() keeps every group of the term (app.js:3313-3315), so Group XI reaches XIf11 here without a change. C76.3 is a list [9, 10] and needs 11.

group_10_stage1_additions.note: Added 7 October 2026 (audit of Group X, F-A-05) so 9080/1 immature teratoma of lung, thymus and thyroid is recordable; 11 was listed in advance.

topography.crosswalk_gap: renderSite() lists coarse_organ_crosswalk rows only (app.js:653-711). A lookup code in no row cannot be picked, so each missing code needs a lookup entry and a crosswalk row.
other_defects: C44.4 is absent, so the C44 rules of Groups IX and X name nine skin codes, not ten (router 726-734, 872-880).
